newsitem.title: JAPAN: INTERVIEW - Global One to pick Japan partner in 97.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Global One to pick Japan partner in 97.

text.p: Multinational telecoms venture Global One will decide on a Japanese business partner by the end of this year, Timothy Wiest, president of the firm's Japanese unit, said in an interview.
"We will have a Japanese partner by the end of this year," Wiest told Reuters.

He also said that the company plans to start offering its services in Japan as soon as possible after the Japanese government allows companies to offer public call services through leased lines from international carriers.

Global One, set up in January 1996 as a joint venture of France Telecom, Deutsche Telekom and Sprint Corp, has already begun offering services such as frame-relay and customised network solution to Japanese customers.
